transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I... well, I guess I'm having some issues at work. I work as a translator. Um. For months now, I’ve been noticing this pattern in the project files. 

It’s... certain subcontractors, and one colleague in particular. They keep making these tiny changes to the translation memory. And the timestamps. Just to make it look like my quality control failed. I mean, IT says the audit trail is clean, but... I know the record has been arranged to put the blame on me. So... I'm here.
Do you think these people are intentionally trying to sabotage you?

Yes. I mean... I wouldn't have brought it up otherwise. It's not a coincidence. 

They're doing it specifically so my quality control looks bad. Like I said, IT claims everything is fine, but... I know what I'm looking at. The records are definitely being manipulated to put the blame on me. So... yes. It's intentional.
Do you think anyone else is involved in this plot against you besides the subcontractors and your colleague?
I don't know. I haven't really looked into anyone else. It's... it's mainly just them that I've noticed. I don't really want to speculate beyond what I've seen.
How long have you believed that your colleague and the subcontractors are sabotaging you?
Um... about 11 months. It started... well, shortly after I was put in charge of the new localization project at work.
Do you think that events or things you see in your daily life, outside of work, are related to this plot against you?

No. It's... it's just work. Outside of that project issue, everything is normal. I still translate, manage the workflow for the rest of my team... pay my bills, do things with my family. None of that has changed. The only time things get... complicated... is when I have to deal with the file history or those specific coworkers. Otherwise, my life is fine.
Have you ever felt like things you see or hear on the news, or from strangers, are somehow related to what's going on with your work project?

No. It's... no. It's just what I said. It's just the files at work and those people. The news is just the news. Strangers are... just strangers. I don't see how they would care about a localization project.
Have you ever felt like things you see or hear, even if they're not directly related to your work, are sending you a message or are about you?
No. I just... I don't know why you keep asking that. It's just the files. I'm not getting messages from anywhere else.
Have you ever felt like you're being sent a message through things you see or hear in your daily life, outside of work?
I... I feel like I just answered that. No. There are no messages. It's exactly like I just said. I don't know what else to tell you.
Have you ever felt like you're being watched or followed, even when you're not at work?
No. Not outside of work. I go home, I stay in my apartment. Nobody is following me to the grocery store or anything like that. It's... it's just the office.
Do you think that anyone or anything is trying to communicate a special message to you, even if it's not directly related to your work?
I... didn't you just ask me that? Twice, actually. I don't... no. There's no special message. I'm just doing my job.
Have you ever thought that events or things that happen to you are specially arranged or happen for a specific reason related to you?
No. I... things just happen. Like they do for anyone else. Nobody is arranging my life for me.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't believe your colleague and the subcontractors were sabotaging you?
Well, no. Not lately. It's... it's been about 11 months now. Basically since they put me in charge of the new localization project. That's when it all started.
Have you ever thought that things you see or hear on TV, or read in a book or newspaper, are referring to you?
No. I... I don't know why they would. I just read the news or watch a show like anyone else. None of it has anything to do with me.
Have you ever felt like something unrelated to your work is happening because of you?
No. I... no, I don't think so. It's really just the situation at work. Outside of that, everything is... fine. I don't know why anything else would have to do with me.
Have you ever thought that strangers are talking about you when you're around them?
No. Um... I don't think so. People usually just mind their own business. I don't really pay much attention to strangers anyway.
Have you ever thought that something on TV, in a book, or in a conversation you overheard, was talking about you or referencing you in some way?
No. I think you already asked me that. I just... I don't pay attention to that kind of stuff. It's just normal TV or normal conversations. None of it is about me.
Have you ever had any doubts about your belief that your colleague and subcontractors are sabotaging you?

No. I... I don't doubt it. Because I see it. For months now, there’s been a clear pattern in the project files. Certain subcontractors, and... that one colleague. They keep making these tiny changes to the translation memory. The timestamps, too. It's just enough to make it look like my quality control failed. 

I know IT claims the audit trail is clean, but... I know what I'm looking at. The record was arranged to put the blame on me. So... no. I don't have any doubts.
How much time do you spend thinking about the situation with your colleague and the subcontractors on a typical day?

I don't know. Um... I don't really keep track. 

Just... when I'm working, mostly. When I have to go in and review the files. I don't really time it or anything.
Would you say that thinking about the situation with your colleague and the subcontractors is interfering with your daily life outside of work?

No, not really. Outside of... that specific issue, everything is fine. I still do my translations. I manage the team's workflow just fine. 

I pay my bills, I... do things with my family. It's normal. It's just... when I have to deal with those specific files, or... those people. That's the only time it's a problem.
